description: Each file here is a copy of a file in bng-metric-harness/example-files/service-template/ (source), built by the harness's corpus recipes or bng-library's generator; its README says how. Refresh them with npm run check:fixtures -- --sync, never by hand.

files.for: A 3-parcel site's baseline-stage file: a baseline upload, and a baseline + post-intervention upload with no post-intervention habitats (POST_INTERVENTION_TABLES_EMPTY)
The same site holding both stages: a baseline + post-intervention upload
small-site-baseline.gpkg under a name that starts with punctuation and holds brackets: accepted, as the filename rule allows both
Two area habitats share the Habitat Ref DUP-1: accepted, as habitats may share a reference
The default site's baseline-stage file
The default site holding both stages: vertical area habitats, an Enhanced tree, Retained, Enhanced and Created features linked to their parents, habitats that get worse
A post-intervention feature whose parent's shape has changed: refused, listing the habitats that do not align
A hedgerow that gets worse without 30+ years created in advance: refused (STAGED_HABITAT_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID)
A baseline area habitat whose Habitat Ref holds the character a decoder puts in place of invalid UTF-8: refused (HABITAT_REF_INVALID_CHARACTERS)
A baseline area habitat, hedgerow (HG004) and watercourse (R002) with no Habitat Ref: refused as one HABITAT_REF_MISSING error
A habitat with no Habitat Ref, in both stages, and a comment holding U+FFFD: refused at the baseline + post-intervention upload (HABITAT_REF_MISSING and COMMENT_INVALID_CHARACTERS)
H005's post-intervention Comment is 1,151 characters: refused (TEXT_TOO_LONG)
H005's post-intervention Comment holds U+FFFD: refused (COMMENT_INVALID_CHARACTERS)
H002 with no Baseline Condition in both stages: refused at the baseline + post-intervention upload (BASELINE_HABITATS_INCOMPLETE naming H002)
H002, HG001 and R007 incomplete in both stages: refused at the baseline + post-intervention upload (BASELINE_HABITATS_INCOMPLETE, count 3)
H005, Created as Lowland meadows (Very High) in its post-intervention row only: refused (HABITAT_DISTINCTIVENESS_NOT_IN_SCOPE)
An area habitat that gets worse with no Habitat Ref on its post-intervention row only: refused at the baseline + post-intervention upload (HABITAT_REF_MISSING)
High and Very High distinctiveness area habitats in both stages: refused (HABITAT_DISTINCTIVENESS_NOT_IN_SCOPE), once for each stage at the baseline + post-intervention upload
T025, a Retained tree marked irreplaceable in both stages: refused (IRREPLACEABLE_TREE)
Advance and delay both set on H005, HG009 and R003 (Created) and H001, HG002 and R006 (Enhanced): accepted, those saved Incomplete
T008, a tree in Good condition, Enhanced: refused (TREE_NOT_ENHANCEABLE)
H001, a Medium area habitat in Good condition, Enhanced: refused (BASELINE_NOT_ENHANCEABLE)
R001, a Medium distinctiveness watercourse in Good condition, Enhanced: refused (BASELINE_NOT_ENHANCEABLE)
HG001, a Very Low distinctiveness hedgerow, Enhanced: refused (BASELINE_NOT_ENHANCEABLE)
A red line boundary drawn as a bowtie: refused (REDLINE_INVALID_GEOMETRY, with the parcel and area checks it sets off)
A red line boundary in Wales: refused (REDLINE_OUTSIDE_ENGLAND and AREA_SUM_MISMATCH)
An empty Red Line Boundary table: refused (NO_REDLINE)
Habitat parcels that do not tile the red line boundary: refused (AREA_SUM_MISMATCH)
H002, an area habitat drawn as a bowtie: refused (AREA_PARCELS_INVALID_GEOMETRY and AREA_SUM_MISMATCH)
H002 and H003 overlap: refused (PARCEL_OVERLAPS and AREA_SUM_MISMATCH)
H002, an area habitat of 0.81 square metres: refused (AREA_PARCELS_TOO_SMALL and AREA_SUM_MISMATCH)
H002, an area habitat outside the red line boundary: refused (AREA_PARCELS_OUTSIDE_REDLINE and AREA_SUM_MISMATCH; the SLIVERS_OUTSIDE_REDLINE it also raises is not shown)
No Area Habitats Baseline table: refused (GPKG_MISSING_LAYER), on the catch-all page
Area Habitats Baseline has no Baseline Condition or Area column: refused (GPKG_BASELINE_MISSING_COLUMN, once for each)
Area Habitats Baseline declares LINESTRING geometry: refused (GPKG_BASELINE_GEOMETRY_TYPE_NAME and GPKG_BASELINE_COLUMN_SQLITE_TYPE)
Red Line Boundary has no geometry column: refused (GPKG_RLB_NO_GEOMETRY_COLUMN), on the catch-all page
Red Line Boundary registers a second geometry column: refused (GPKG_BASELINE_MULTIPLE_GEOMETRY_COLUMNS), on the catch-all page

Baseline-stage file for watercourse-degraded.gpkg
A watercourse whose encroachment alone gets worse, 10 years in advance, and one in a lower condition: accepted
Baseline-stage file for watercourse-remeandered.gpkg: R003, a 100 m ditch
R003 re-meandered onto a 130 m route, Enhanced by Realignment: accepted, priced on 130 m with no length lost
Baseline-stage file for every-retention.gpkg: vertical area habitats V001-V004
Vertical area habitats V001 Retained, V002 Enhanced, V003 Created (IGGI), V004 Lost
A vertical area habitat with no Area: refused (VERTICAL_HABITAT_AREA_NOT_POSITIVE)
Created area habitats
H005, Created, with no target condition or timing: accepted, saved Incomplete

H005, Created and linked to its parent, with no habitat type: refused with STAGED_HABITAT_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID, not a missing-type error. The service reads a blank Proposed Habitat Type as the row's Baseline one, so it takes H005 as Created in its parent's own type, a habitat that gets worse (see the harness README)

T007 put back after a 5-year delay in its baseline condition: accepted

A tree felled and a new one planted in its place, linked to it: accepted

The default site with the Created HG015 given no Proposed Condition, years created in advance or delay: accepted, HG015 saved Incomplete
The default site with the Enhanced R006's encroachments reduced to Minor and No Encroachment/No Encroachment, against its baseline Major and Moderate/Minor: accepted
